entries.name: G0A.SUM
entries.note: sum of a Vector of numbers (0 for empty)

entries.name: G0A.WORDS
entries.note: split a String on spaces, dropping empty pieces

entries.name: G0A.MEAN
entries.body: 'MV' BIND MV G0A.SUM MV LENGTH DIV

entries.name: U2A.ORDERS
entries.note: JSON String -> the Vector of Records under its "orders" key

entries.name: U2A.GSUM
entries.body: GROUP 'GSR' BIND GSR KEYS GSR VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
entries.note: keys Vector, values Vector -> Record from each distinct key to the sum of its values, first-appearance order

entries.name: U2D.DEVS
entries.note: Vector of numbers -> each number minus the mean, in order

entries.name: U2D.VAR
entries.body: U2D.DEVS 'D' BIND D D MUL G0A.MEAN

entries.name: U2A.DIVS
entries.body: 'DN' BIND 1 DN RANGE [ 'DX' BIND DN DX DIV FLOOR DX MUL DN EQ ] FILTER
entries.note: positive integer -> Vector of its positive divisors, ascending
